new_facts: Nvidia agrees to acquire Hugging Face for exact figure $12,930,300,000, per Jensen Huang's own announcement.
Hugging Face approached Nvidia's Huang weeks before the deal was finalized, per CEO interview.
Hugging Face hosts over 3 million models and is used by over 18 million developers.
Hugging Face was founded in 2016.
Deal is Nvidia's second-biggest purchase after paying $20B for Groq assets last year.
Hugging Face previously turned down a large investment offer from Huang's Nvidia to preserve independence.
stories.line: Nvidia is acquiring Hugging Face, an open-source AI platform, for $12.9 billion, consolidating control over a major tool used by AI developers.
